items.title: A new way to make better use of ruthenium in single-atom catalysts
items.snippet: Ruthenium (Ru) is a valuable metal used in catalysts to speed up chemical reactions in many industrial processes. It can help improve efficiency and reduce the energy needed for chemical production. However, because it is rare and expensive, scientists are looking for ways to make better use of it.

items.title: Historical records reveal the bitter truth about 17th-century Transylvania's climate
items.snippet: For roughly five centuries from about 1300, Europe experienced periods of unusually cold weather and extreme conditions collectively known as the Little Ice Age. Transylvania, a historical region in modern-day Romania, was also affected, but information about just how severe things were had been scattered in old town records, church logs, travelogs and administrative and monastic diaries.

items.title: Fighting accent bias is everyone's job, not just accented speakers'
